recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **World Duel Rush: Portrait Grand Prix** as a single-file browser game. Preserve the original mobile canvas survival arena mechanics: pointer joystick movement, automatic nearest-target firing, homing enemies, enemy contact damage, dropped XP pickups with magnet behavior, score and HP HUD, level-up upgrade choices, wave escalation, game-over, and restart. Transform the presentation into a Street-Fighter-inspired global arcade tournament: a blue-gold challenger at center, red/violet rival rush silhouettes from the edges, cyan readable special move streaks, golden momentum sparks, combo-card upgrade choices, and an animated portrait fighting stage with flags, crowd bands, ring ropes, spotlights, scanlines, and punchy arcade UI. Optimize for portrait mobile viewports from 4:7 to 9:16 with large tappable buttons and unobstructed playfield controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile portrait canvas survival arena / auto-shooter
- objective: survive while moving the hero, auto-firing at nearest enemies, collecting dropped XP, increasing score, and selecting upgrades on level-up
- input model: pointer/touch virtual joystick anywhere on the playfield; UI buttons remain native click/tap targets
- core loop: resize canvas, update on requestAnimationFrame, move hero, spawn homing enemies, auto-shoot nearest target, resolve projectile/enemy/hero/XP collisions, update HUD, draw frame
- fail/friction state: enemy contact damages HP and destroys the enemy; HP <= 0 enters game-over with final score and restart

## Protected Mechanics
- Pointer joystick vector, clamp, and release behavior
- Hero speed, bounds clamping, auto-fire cadence/range, projectile travel/life/damage
- Enemy off-screen spawning, homing movement, contact damage, soft separation, and wave-based spawn acceleration
- XP drop, magnet radius, pickup scoring, level-up threshold growth, upgrade choice effects, wave increment after upgrade
- Score additions, HP bar semantics, game-over/restart state flow, and silent mobile audio fallback

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, panels, typography, palette, canvas rendering of fighter/rivals/projectiles/orbs, particles, background scene, feedback copy, button styling, audio labels, and screenshot-facing composition can change without altering mechanics.

## Rebuild Direction
Rebuild as a portrait-first arcade fighting tournament survival duel: the hero becomes a World Circuit Challenger, auto-fire becomes readable special move timing, rivals rush in from the edges, XP becomes momentum sparks, upgrades become combo cards, and the stage becomes a procedural global finals arena.
